description: Na₄Mg₃(PO₄)₂(P₂O₇) crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.61 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.60 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.82 Å. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.19 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.64 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.26 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-47°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.66 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MgP tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MgP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaMg₂P trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom to form distorted ONaMg₂P tetrahedra that share corners with three ONa₂MgP tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONaMg₂P trigonal pyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mg, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom.
